metadata.description: David Lambl's Claude Code mods, skills and plugins.

plugins.name: context-bar
plugins.description: Your context window as a meter above the prompt: the conversation, the overhead every request carries, and the room left before compaction, with a drill-down into the overhead. Toggle it with /context-bar.

plugins.name: api-call
plugins.description: Calls an API the way your Insomnia or Postman collection would, with its environment, auth and client certificate, records the exchange as JSON with every secret masked, and screenshots it on request.

plugins.name: ado-evidence
plugins.description: Posts images with captions as a markdown comment on an Azure DevOps work item, or revises one already posted, and checks that every image rendered.
